message: The other day, I found myself cleaning out the kitchen drawers and stumbled upon an old fire escape plan I drew up with my kids years ago. It was a little crumpled, but it made me smile to see our creative doodles and the silly routes we came up with. Rediscovering that low-tech fun reminded me how important it is to revisit our safety plans together — and maybe even turn it into a family game! Have you chatted with your loved ones about your escape routes lately?
